body.en: At the Bureau they petition a yam paiza for you — show it to change horses.

body.zh: 丹吉尔：白图泰记下的城门、市声与礼拜。The first city, therefore, at which he arrived, was Tilimsān; the next Milyāna; the next El Jazāer (Algiers): the next Bijāya; the next Kosantīna the next Būna; the next Tūnis; the
body.en: The first city, therefore, at which he arrived, was Tilimsān; the next Milyāna; the next El Jazāer (Algiers): the next Bijāya; the next Kosantīna the next Būna; the next Tūnis; the next Sawsa; the next Safākus.

body.zh: 香料与织物在丹吉尔市集上叠成气味的墙。
body.en: Spice and cloth stack into walls of scent in Tangier.

body.zh: 礼拜的呼声从丹吉尔的宣礼塔落下。
body.en: The call to prayer falls from the minarets of Tangier.

body.zh: 丹吉尔工匠用本地的手艺换远路来的银。
body.en: Craftsmen of Tangier trade local skill for distant silver.

body.zh: 开罗：白图泰记下的城门、市声与礼拜。It is also said of the Sheikh Jamāl Oddīn, that after he had gone to Damietta, he constantly attended the burial-grounds of that place. There was at that time in Damietta a judge,
body.en: It is also said of the Sheikh Jamāl Oddīn, that after he had gone to Damietta, he constantly attended the burial-grounds of that place. There was at that time in Damietta a judge, known by the surname of Ibn Omaid, who, attending one day at the funeral of one of the nobles, saw the Sheikh in the burial-ground, and said to him, you are a beastly old fellow. He replied, And you are a foolish judge, who can pass with yo

body.en: From this place I proceeded to Acca: in this is the tomb of Sālih the prophet, which I visited. After this I arrived at the city of Tyre, which is a place wonderfully strong, being surrounded on three sides by the sea. Its harbour is one of those which have been much celebrated. body.en: AT this time, that is, in the year 729 (A.D. 1328), prayer was made, during the sermon, for the King of Irak Abu Saīd, and after that for El Melik El Nāsir. I remained there during the third year also, and then left Mecca with the intention of visiting Yemen. I arrived accordingly at Judda. From this place I went with a Company of merchants who were going to Yemen; but, as the wind changed upon us, we put into the is

body.en: THE river (just mentioned) is the Sinde: it is the greatest river in the world, and overflows during the hot weather just as the Nile does; and at this time they sow the lands. Here also commence the territories of the Emperor of Sindia and India, who was at this time Mohammed Shāh. From this place also is the description of persons arriving sent in writing to the Emīr of Sindia to Multān. Their Emīr, at this time, w

body.en: We next arrived at the city of Manjarūn, which is situated upon a large estuary of the sea, called the “ q estuary of the wolf,” and which is the greatest estuary in the country of Malabar. In this place are some of the greatest merchants of Persia and Yemen. Ginger and black pepper are here in great abundance. The king of this place is the greatest of the kings of Malabar, and in it are about four thousand Mohammeda

body.en: Between sand and caravans, someone asks if you know the rites.

text.en: Good omen: a side path appears.

body.zh: 巴格达的余晖把大马士革的尖塔提前画在眼底。
body.en: Baghdad’s afterglow paints Damascus minarets onto the eye.

label.en: Ask the season with astral dice

body.zh: 尼罗河边，一名法官请你旁听：商队是否隐瞒了关税。
body.en: By the Nile a qadi asks you to witness: did the caravan hide the duty?

body.zh: 账册上的墨迹新旧不一。译员看你一眼，等人开口。
body.en: Ink on the ledger is uneven. The interpreter waits for you to speak.

body.zh: 法官宣判完毕。尼罗的风把你的名字写进这座城的传闻。
body.en: The qadi finishes. Nile wind writes your name into the city’s talk.

body.zh: 麦加城外，向导问你是否已洁净、是否知绕行的方向。
body.en: Outside Mecca a guide asks if you are purified and know the circuit.

body.zh: 人潮如河。你须在拥挤中保持方向，也保持记录的手不抖。
body.en: The crowd is a river. Keep direction — and a steady hand for the pen.

body.zh: 仪成。你可把麦加写成归途的圆心，而非终点。
body.en: Rites done. Mecca can be written as the center of returns — not an end.
